title: Bearer credentials in authorization headers: must be flagged
summary: Bearer values of adequate length in `Authorization` and `Proxy-Authorization` headers, separated by spaces or tabs, and a value below the project length floor as a twin. Covers 2 inputs.
rationale: Bearer tokens have no provider format. The header context and the value's length are the only signals, so they are project policy, stated as such.

expectation.rationale: Independently authored public conformance row for the bounded credential project-policy contract.
